claims.claim: OpenAI is testing a unified Chat and Work experience that combines the two tabs and shares a single usage allowance.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI is testing a change that removes the separate “Work” tab inside ChatGPT and brings everything into one chat window.
claims.source_title: ChatGPT Merges Chat and Work and Shares Its Usage Limit With Codex
claims.supporting_quote: Four months after launching ChatGPT Work, OpenAI is scrapping the Work tab again, following Anthropic’s playbook for the second time this year.

claims.claim: Wired uncovered roughly 400 apps and websites that looked like normal AI tools but hid features for creating violent deepfake images and videos.
claims.episode_span: A Wired investigation found roughly 400 apps and websites, mostly tied to Chinese-language developers, that looked like normal AI image or chat tools but hid features letting users create violent or non-consensual deepfake images and videos.
claims.source_title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
claims.supporting_quote: WIRED uncovered some 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that look like regular AI tools but had secret features that let users create violent AI-generated images and video.
